description: This file defines the 'ExecutionStatus' type and related constants, functions for normalizing status strings, and checking if a status is terminal within the system.

methods.name: NormalizeExecutionStatus
methods.description: Converts an input status string to the canonical execution status recognized by the system, mapping aliases to standard statuses and defaulting to 'unknown' for unrecognized inputs.

methods.name: IsTerminalExecutionStatus
methods.description: Determines if a given status string represents a terminal state (success, failure, cancellation, timeout).
